en.heading: Supplier Portal
en.introduction: Register as a new supplier or sign in to manage your profile, respond to sourcing and track your invoices with ASFAR.
en.registration_intro: New to ASFAR? Choose the registration that matches your company's status.
en.signin_description: Sign in to the ASFAR supplier portal to manage your profile, respond to sourcing events and track your invoices and payments.
en.inquiry_description: For any inquiries, please contact the ASFAR Procurement team.

ar.signin_description: سجّل الدخول إلى بوابة الموردين لإدارة ملفك، والمشاركة في المنافسات، ومتابعة فواتيرك ومدفوعاتك.
